summary: Master Fraud Detection in banking with our comprehensive course. Learn to implement Machine Learning models in Python for effective risk management.
lede: Fraud detection using machine learning in Python helps banking fraud professionals turn transaction records into scored alerts for investigation. For fraud analysts and operations teams, the workflow covers cleaning transaction data, engineering signals, and training supervised or anomaly-detection models. They can compare performance using precision, recall, F1 score, and AUPRC, set alert thresholds, and explore monitoring and reporting workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle banking fraud data, model performance, alert investigation, and fraud governance in day-to-day operations. It fits people who need to turn transaction records into usable fraud detection outputs with Python and machine learning.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of banking transaction processes, basic statistics, and familiarity with Excel or a similar spreadsheet tool. You should be comfortable using a laptop for Python labs, but prior machine learning implementation experience is not required. The course teaches Python at an applied foundation-to-intermediate level, so coding/programming is required for the hands-on labs, though advanced engineering is not expected. Participants will benefit most if they can interpret fraud alerts, investigation notes, chargeback patterns, or suspicious activity reporting workflows in their own organization.
